applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
The available quota route depends on the store's registration region.

| Store registration | Quota route |
|---|---|
| Mainland China | Select the CedarPay authorization option when binding the collection account on GOAT. |
| Other regions | Submit sales records manually; this authorization route is unavailable. |

If the authorization option was not selected during binding, bind the collection account again and select the option. If an authorized store still has a quota shortfall, submit the original sales records, seller ID and collection account to support for investigation.

title: GOAT authorization by registration region
